newsitem.title: USA: Shared says to merge into Tel-Save.
newsitem.headline: Shared says to merge into Tel-Save.

text.p: Shared Technologies Fairchild Inc said Thursday it signed an agreement to merge into a wholly- owned subsidiary Tel-Save Holdings Inc.
Shared stockholders will receive shares of Tel-Save stock, with a value of $11.25 per share for each share of common stock of Shared.
Shared said the price of the stock may rise based on the market price of Tel-Save's stock at the time of the merger.
A company spokesman said the total value of the deal is about $511 million.
The company said it expects to complete the merger, which is subject to antitrust and regulatory clearances, in December.
Tel-Save is a long- distance service provider. Shared is a telecommunications company.
